# Wildercord 0.14.0-alpha — One road

**Minecraft Java 26.3 · Fabric · Java 25**

Install `wildercord-0.14.0-alpha+mc26.3.jar` on the server and every client, with Fabric API
0.161.0+26.3 and Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer. This update adds items and packets, so **0.13.x
clients must update before joining**. Keep only one Wildercord JAR in `mods`. The sources JAR is
for development.

**Back up your worlds first.**

## Highlights

- **Four Lamps, One Road**: light the Reedlands, Highland, Belowkeeper and Emberwood lamps and
  answer each regional keeper to finish a journal capstone that ends with the Lamplighter's
  Lantern.
- **New companions**: tame a coffer mimic with books (it follows you and opens as a 27-slot chest
  only you can use) or a thistle hedgehog with sweet berries (it brings you forage finds).
- **Bosses hit harder and move better**: blows land 35% harder and part of them goes through
  armour, with clearer wind-ups, follow-through and staged deaths.
- **Grander buildings**: the world's dungeons and sites were rebuilt bigger and richer, from the
  Ember Sanctum's buttressed hall and crowned dome to the root temple's stepped pyramid. Forest
  sites clear the trees over themselves. The new versions appear in newly generated chunks.
- **Quality of life**: stow Weaver's Silk with `G` or `/silk`, rename homes, and gathering bounties
  and caravans now deal in regional goods.

The full list, with every fix, is in the [changelog](../../CHANGELOG.md).

## Testing and known limits

This build was tested on the Windows test machine: the unit and tooling tests, the native release
smoke suite, ten per-area native suites (combat, rituals, regions, items, GUIs, mounts, towns and a
feature tour) and a screenshot pass over all 76 structures. Those suites cover the main journeys,
not every feature. This is an alpha: report problems on the issue tracker.

# Wildercord 0.13.0-alpha — Living world

**Minecraft Java 26.3 · Fabric · Java 25**

Install `wildercord-0.13.0-alpha+mc26.3.jar` on the server and every client, with Fabric API
0.161.0+26.3 and Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer. This update adds blocks, items, entities and
packets, so **0.12.x clients must update before joining**. Keep only one Wildercord JAR in
`mods`. The sources JAR is for development.

**Back up your worlds first.**

## New places to find

Each region has its own biome, a building, a resident, a lore route in your journal and a boss.

- **Luminous Reedlands**: pale banks and Moonreed pools, the Tideward Reedkeeper Landing, the
  Drowned Road and the Reed-Crowned Ferryman at the Last Crossing.
- **Windscar Highlands**: the Cairn Lodge and Cairn Keeper, the Paired Cairns and the Glass
  Cartographer, joined to the Scout's Last Cairn.
- **Belowkeeper Hollows**: a Listening Station, its Listener, the Empty Bell route and the
  Hollow Bell.
- **Emberwood Reach**: a Charcoal Yard, its Kiln Keeper, the Eleven Winters route and the Kiln
  Widow.

## Also in this release

Wider bounties and escort jobs, inn raids and rooms, hamlets and wandering caravans, ritual
spells, flawed runes, a spell-duel arena, flying, water and burrowing mounts, guilds, covens and
co-op tribulations, ascension past the Twentieth Circle, a codex bestiary and a stats page. The
full list, with every fix, is in the [changelog](../../CHANGELOG.md).

## Testing and known limits

This build passed the 115 tooling tests and the 14-class native smoke suite on the Windows test
machine. The old 349-class native gate was retired, so a smoke pass is not proof that every
feature works. This is an alpha: report problems on the issue tracker.

# Wildercord 0.12.0-alpha — Tempering

**Minecraft Java 26.3 · Fabric · Java 25**

Install `wildercord-0.12.0-alpha+mc26.3.jar` on the server and every client, with Fabric API
0.161.0+26.3 and Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer. This update adds blocks, items, entities, effects
and packets, so **0.11.x clients must update before joining**. Keep only one Wildercord JAR in
`mods`. The sources JAR is for development.

**Back up your worlds first.** Saves are re-tempered the first time each player joins: hearts and
auras are measured against the new thresholds, so players can lose circles and aura stages.
Condensed mana and aura experience are kept, so lost circles and stages form again as the player
plays.

## Players are no longer gods

- **Spells hit for less.** Less damage per hit and per cast, less for each point of mana spent,
  and a share-out past the third target. A hit's bonuses can multiply a spell by at most 3x
  against a creature. Spell power from circles is halved.
- **Defences don't stack into immunity.**
  - Lasting Resistance is capped at II. Split-second dodges, like Time Skip, keep their level.
  - Aura armour gives 15%, down from 25%.
  - Boss and Master spells skip the spell guard.
  - A blade guard only takes a quarter off a spell, so Sword Masters no longer erase magic.

## Circles and aura take real effort

- About **a hundred hours to circle 20**: around six hours for circle 5 and twenty-five for
  circle 10.
- Only a tenth of the mana you spend condenses straight away. The rest condenses only when your
  spells hurt hostile creatures. Spell farms mostly stop counting, and the 7th Circle's boss
  breakthrough needs you to have truly fought.
- Aura stage thresholds are tripled, so Sovereign takes about 45 hours.
- Your aura now shows only while you're using it.

## Breakthroughs that matter

- **Tribulations.** The 5th, 10th, 15th and 20th circles must be won against three to six waves
  of tempered Runebound, with a Herald in the last. A win leaves runes and Mana Crystals, and a
  **Tribulation Scar**: one more heart of health for good.
- A **breakthrough screen** shows what the circle gave and opened, and warns you when the next
  circle is a tribulation. The great breakthroughs are announced to the server.

## The world fights back

- **Tempered enemies** scale to the strongest player nearby: up to 4x health and 2.5x damage.
- **Elites**: Swift, Ironhide, Vampiric, Brutal and Splitting.
- **Bosses** grow with each extra challenger, and the simpler ones enrage at half health.
- Wildercord's monsters spawn **twice as often**, mostly in packs.
- **Frost and Ash** Bramblewalkers and Gloomstalkers depend on where they're born.
- Gloomstalker packs are led by **Alphas**.

## Cooking, mounts and a town

- **Camp Pot cooking**: 21 meals with buffs for the road, plus the Nourished and Focused effects.
- **Ridgeback Stag**: the first mount. Tame it, saddle it, ride it and breed it.
- **Black bobcat**: a rare, polar-bear-sized wildcat you can tame with fish.
- **Wayfarer Inn town life**: a daily bounty board, reputation from Stranger to Honoured, and
  three keepers whose stock grows with your standing.
  - The **Inn Cook** sells meals and the Camp Pot.
  - The **Stablemaster** sells saddles, horse armour and a Ridgeback Deed.
  - The **Master's Emissary** sells runes, aura shards and a technique scroll.

## Fixes

- Name tags always name Wildercord's creatures and keep the name shown.
- In a Sword Master trial, burning, poison, wither and freeze you left on the Master still count
  after you step out of the arena.

## Updating worlds

Existing chunks are unchanged. Only Wayfarer Inns generated on 0.12 have the bounty board and
keepers. Creatures already in the world aren't tempered: only those that appear from now on are.

# Wildercord 0.11.2-alpha — Worldgen crash fix

**Minecraft Java 26.3 · Fabric · Java 25**

Install `wildercord-0.11.2-alpha+mc26.3.jar` on the server and every client, with Fabric API
0.161.0+26.3 and Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer. Server and players should run the same build.
No world changes: 0.11 worlds load as they are. Keep only one Wildercord JAR in `mods`; the
sources JAR is for development.

## Fixes

- Generating new chunks no longer crashes the server when a farm site, such as the walled
  orchard, places its sign. The sign's text is now written safely while the chunk is still
  being generated. 0.11.1 servers that explore new land should update.

Everything from 0.11.1 (a stronger Cinnamon and the screen fixes) is included.

# Wildercord 0.11.1-alpha — A stronger Cinnamon and screen fixes

**Minecraft Java 26.3 · Fabric · Java 25**

Install `wildercord-0.11.1-alpha+mc26.3.jar` on the server and every client, with Fabric API
0.161.0+26.3 and Fabric Loader 0.19.5 or newer. Server and players should run the same build.
No world changes: 0.11.0 worlds load as they are. Keep only one Wildercord JAR in `mods`; the
sources JAR is for development.

## Cinnamon

While treats keep Cinnamon big, she grows stronger: a harder bite, double health, armour and a
bigger fatigue budget. She joins her owner's fights and casts fire, frost, lightning and arcane
bolts at their enemies, plus a healing beam when her owner drops below half health. Her spells
follow her owner's friendly-fire rules and never join a Master's trial. At normal size she is
unchanged.

## Fixes

- Tooltips in the Cord screen show again: the mana, heart, defence and help badges, spell
  sockets and Codex runes. A spell description beside the tool buttons left its clipping region
  open, which hid every tooltip drawn after it.
- Opening a Master study you can't read yet (circle too low, or the boss victory missing) now
  stays open and says what it needs, instead of closing at once.
- The Aura screen's Master form link moved into the header beside the title, so it no longer runs
  across the breathing-method portrait. On the Writing, Blade and Lineage tabs, the method, stage
  and aura line fits between the link and Master's Arts instead of printing over them.
